Description: Recorded on May 15, 1986, this bulletin presents what Dr. Rashad Khalifa calls the most important news in the history of the world, delivered with what he describes as a built-in proof of authenticity that any listener may examine. He announces that 1986 is the last year of the world as then known, that a new worldwide era will begin between September 6, 1986 and August 25, 1987 and last 303 lunar years, and that the world will end in 2280, treating the time until then as the close of a demonstration of Satan's claim to be a god besides God. He states three minimum requirements for membership in the coming kingdom of God: belief in the one true God without idolizing any creature, belief in the Hereafter, and a righteous life. The remainder is addressed by name to religious leaders, inviting Billy Graham, Pat Robertson, Jerry Falwell, Robert Schuller, Oral Roberts and Jimmy Swaggart to stop calling Jesus God, Pope John Paul II to lead his followers away from idolizing Jesus, Mary and the saints, Rabbi Kushner to retract what Khalifa reads as a denial of God's omnipotence, and the leaders of the Islamic world to abandon man-made fabrications, closing with the insistence that the judgment expressed is God's and not his own.
